answer: Three unbooked custodian items explain the whole [F6] cash break: book them for the fund controller's approval before the net asset value is struck.
exec_summary: Our system shows [F1] of cash against the custodian's [F2], a break of [F6].
A dividend of [F3] and a subscription of [F4] are at the custodian but not booked.
The custodian paid the [F5] audit fee we still show as accrued.
Net, the three items come to [F8], the whole break.
situation: A fund whose cash is checked against the custodian before each net asset value strike.
complication: Fund cash in our system is below the custodian's, hours before the strike.
key_question: What explains the cash break, and what must be booked before the net asset value is struck?

titles.situation: Fund cash disagrees with the custodian before the strike.
titles.options: Two ways to handle the break before the strike.
titles.recommendation: Book all three items for approval before the strike.
titles.roadmap: Clear the break tonight, then book custodian cash daily.
titles.kpis: Two measures show cash is clean at each strike.
titles.risks: The main risk is booking the subscription into tonight's valuation.

issue_tree.finding: Cash has arrived at the custodian that we have not booked.
points: The dividend of [F3] and the subscription of [F4] total [F7].

hypotheses.text: The dividend was already accrued as receivable.

issue_tree.so_what: If the dividend was not accrued, the draft value is understated by [F10].

chart.title: Cash in our system and at the custodian.

issue_tree.finding: The custodian paid a fee we still show as owed.
points: The audit fee of [F5] is still an accrual in our system.

hypotheses.text: The fee payment changes the fund's value.

issue_tree.so_what: Booking the payment clears the accrual without moving the value.

issue_tree.finding: The subscription belongs to tomorrow's dealing, not tonight's value.
points: The subscription of [F4] arrived for tomorrow's dealing.

hypotheses.text: The subscription should lift tonight's value.

issue_tree.so_what: It is booked as received in advance, outside tonight's value.

options.name: Book all three
options.description: Book the dividend, the subscription received in advance and the fee payment for approval.

options.name: Strike with a note
options.description: Strike tonight with the break noted and book tomorrow.

recommendation.rationale: It clears the whole [F6] break before the strike and keeps the subscription out of tonight's value; the fund controller approves the entries and the strike.

actions: Book the three entries tonight once the fund controller approves, before the strike.

risks.risk: The subscription is counted in tonight's value.
risks.mitigation: Book it as received in advance for tomorrow's dealing.

risks.risk: The dividend is booked against income and a receivable.
risks.mitigation: Check for an existing receivable before booking.
